children: Vietnam exported 1.33 million metric tons of coffee in the first eight months of 2026, up 13.7% from the same period a year earlier, government data showed on Thursday.
Coffee export revenues over the period fell by 8.6% to $6 billion, the Statistics Office said in a report.
In August alone, the country exported 132,000 tons, up 13.7% annually.
